a_before_b.rationale: Defining evaluation methods and data does not require prior mastery of data quality dimensions; one can select methods, annotate data, and slice production slices without explicitly applying completeness, uniqueness, validity, accuracy, consistency, or fitness for purpose.

b_before_a.rationale: Listing and defining data quality dimensions does not depend on knowing how to define evaluation methods, annotate evaluation data, or slice data for production slices.
